opportunities.title: The Company That Tracks Hackers Just Got Hacked: What Chainalysis's Breach Says About 'Security' Vendors
opportunities.why_now: A firm whose entire business is post-hack forensics just had password hashes and live tokens exposed, which is the kind of irony that writes itself.
opportunities.angle: Incident teardown — walk through what was exposed, what live tokens actually enable, and why 'we investigate hacks' isn't the same as 'we can't be hacked'

opportunities.title: Mercado Bitcoin Said the Hack Was 'Contained.' The Blockchain Says Otherwise.
opportunities.why_now: A live contradiction between an exchange's PR statement and verifiable on-chain data dropped the same week the exchange announced a phased reopening and pledged to cover losses.
opportunities.angle: On-chain fact-check — line up the official statement against the transaction trail, timestamp by timestamp

opportunities.title: Cold Storage Ratios Are the New 'We Take Security Seriously'
opportunities.why_now: Exchanges are suddenly publishing cold-wallet percentages days after Binance got hit, which is exactly the kind of after-the-fact reassurance that precedes the next headline.
opportunities.angle: Skeptical breakdown — explain what cold storage ratio actually does and doesn't protect against, and why a number on a blog post isn't an audit

opportunities.title: The Fake Interview That's Hit Dozens of Crypto Companies Before Binance — And Will Hit More
opportunities.why_now: Chainalysis's own research shows DPRK's fake-interview playbook was battle-tested on smaller targets for years before the $6.3B Binance heist, meaning the next victim is already being recruited.
opportunities.angle: Pattern-recognition explainer — lay out the attack lifecycle (job post → interview → malware) as a checklist readers can use to spot it happening to them

opportunities.title: BitMart's Founder Just Confirmed What Everyone Already Suspected About Exchange Security Teams
opportunities.why_now: A founder admitting his security team was 'severely understaffed' right after a hack is a rare on-record confirmation of the staffing problem this channel has been flagging for years.
opportunities.angle: Quote-driven analysis — use the admission as proof point for a broader argument about exchanges treating security as a cost center until it's too late
